master.note: The 3D terrain is still built from this September penup master.

projection.area_note: lake areas are true sphere areas (projection area factor sin(rho)/rho applied); *_flat_ruler uses km_per_master_px squared only

registration.method: ICP on coastline ink (earth_re ink minus its additions) against penup grey ink; bbox-similarity start; trimmed gates 40->2.5 px; affine then homography; matrices map source px (x,y,1) -> master px

frame_tests.verdict: kiros_earth_re, kiros_v5 and saphaun_drawn_edit are the clean saphaun coastline scan (Copy of saphaun_drawn_Empty.jpg; earth_re and v5 at exactly half size) plus hand-drawn marks. One registration serves all of them.

maps/Map_West_Mountains_Trees.JPG.verdict: pixel crop of Copy of saphaun_drawn_Empty.jpg (2x frame) at x 0..1240, y 72..1711, plus stamped symbols

lakes.method: blue ink loops; area = inside of the ink centerline; small gaps closed by binary closing (gap_closed_px); earth_re areas carried to master px by the homography Jacobian

mountain_marks.method: penup: grey ink with land on all sides (masks.py rule); earth_re: non-blue additions to the base. Strokes = 8-connected components >= 6 px; length ~ half the stroke perimeter. A stroke counts in every config range box containing its centroid (as terrain.py does). Landmass = penup land component nearest the stroke, named by config regions seeds.

master_frame.note: ink only, transparent background; v5 is the full-color biome map, transparent outside its frame

window.uv: u = (lon + 84) / 162, v = (lat + 14) / 98 (v = 0 at the bottom row)
window.note: ink lines at least ~2 px wide; lake interiors filled at 35% alpha (penup Dire inner depression gets a second 35% layer)

map_a.evidence: visual: after the rotation the long western island (Ender) sits west, the continent with the lake inside crossing ranges (Fiira/Veir) west-center, the northern continent with a lake (Roan/Sfere) north-east, the crescent continent with a heart-shaped lake and a spine of marks along its outer edge (Malos/Dire) south-east, the hatched round island (Dragon) south-west and the island chain along the north, as on the master. Coastline geometry is older and is not registered.
map_a.correlation_note: weak supporting number only (different geometry, pencil shading)

kiros_map_previous.note: Older geometry: the coastlines are drawn differently, so the image is not registered and no overlay is produced.

rough_similarity_from_lake_centers.note: three manually seeded lake centers only; reference for orientation, not a registration

frame_legend.master: penup master grid (1362x1155), the grid the 3D terrain is built on
frame_legend.v5-frame: the saphaun coastline scan frame shared by kiros_v5 / kiros_earth_re (1208x954) and saphaun_drawn_* (2416x1908 = exactly 2x); registered to the master by the matrix in registration
frame_legend.v5-frame-crop: a crop/scale of the v5 frame (see registration.extra)
frame_legend.outline-scan: same coastline drawing, its own scan frame; registered to the master in registration.extra
frame_legend.rotated-older: older geometry drawn rotated relative to north-up

frame_legend.painted-derivative: a painted or AI-made render made from one of the drawings; not a source of geometry

Biome map: the saphaun coastline scan with colored marker zones (green hatching, light-green/teal/yellow/purple region outlines), brown zigzag mountain marks (ring around Lake Veir, Malos spine, Dragon isle, north isles), blue lakes (Veir, Sfere, Dire with a filled dark-blue inner area), and a hand-drawn N/E/S/W compass.

Penup drawing (photo, 1362x1155): grey-ink coastlines of all landmasses and island chains, grey zigzag mountain marks (a ring of marks around Lake Veir, NW Fiira, the north isle, Roan, NE isles, Malos spine, Dragon isle), blue-ink lake outlines: Lake Veir (with three small marks inside), Sfere, Dire Lake with a small inner loop. No labels. The master grid of the 3D terrain.

Clean coastline-only scan (2416x1908): black/grey ink coastlines, island chains and dotted lines, no marks, no lakes, no labels. It is the base of kiros_v5, kiros_earth_re and saphaun_drawn_edit at exactly 2x.

Newest revision (Drive 2026-10-10): the clean saphaun coastline scan with new marks only: small blue lake loops (Veir, a tiny Sfere loop, a narrow Dire Lake with no inner loop) and brown zigzag mountain lines (NW Fiira diagonal, one Veir diagonal line east of the lake, two Roan lines, the Malos spine along the east coast, a short mark on Dragon isle). No marks on the northern islands, no labels.
